pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’s flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

pokedexEntries.sh: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

pokedexEntries.sc: It spins its tail fins to leap from the water, then viciously bites down on Wingull flying close to the water’s surface.

pokedexEntries.vi: It swims at speeds of over 100 knots and battles fiercely with pods of Finizen over prey.
